blockers.title: GitHub autonomous merge and required-check authority is not established
blockers.description: AGENTS.md reserves repository security settings and main merges for explicit owner authorization. CI can be prepared in a PR, but rulesets, merge queue, tokens/secrets, and unattended merge acceptance require owner action.
blockers.next_step: Keep PR-based integration; prepare a least-privilege setup checklist without changing repository settings.

blockers.title: Baseline branch head and complete CI workflow inventory need fresh verification
blockers.description: The reboot-core base SHA and all 15 workflow filenames in the candidate's removal diff have been identified. Nine workflows have successful baseline runs. The remaining work is a policy/compatibility audit, tracked separately as BLK-003.
blockers.next_step: No action; retain the baseline workflow inventory as evidence.

blockers.title: Unified CI candidate needs safety and cost corrections before port
blockers.description: The unified workflow's PR-head run 44424340406 completed with Layer 0 and Layer 1 successful. The stale E-007 source-manifest path is fixed, all 15 legacy workflow responsibilities are mapped, manual expensive jobs remain opt-in, and the workflow has no concurrency groups. The E-009 shared-runner smoke passed but explicitly does not constitute a capacity claim. A fresh run is still required after PR #64 is integrated and PR #65 is retargeted.
blockers.next_step: After PR #64 is integrated into research/reboot-core, retarget PR #65 and verify a fresh all-green run before merge.

blockers.title: Decision-grade M3 model evaluation needs an approved GPU or API execution path
blockers.description: The unified workflow retains the existing Ollama/Qwen3 CPU job only as a manual diagnostic. It cannot be used to satisfy the v0.1 M3 acceptance gate, which requires a strong model and representative stochastic cohorts on an approved GPU or API path.
blockers.next_step: Obtain owner approval for a bounded API/GPU budget and credentials/runner before enabling the decision-grade cohort.

blockers.title: Shared-runner E-009 smoke incorrectly enforced capacity thresholds
blockers.description: Removed --enforce-capacity-gate from the always-on E-009 product-path smoke while preserving it in the manual ten-repetition capacity confirmation. Run 44428892897 passed Layer 0 and Layer 1, and the E-009 smoke had zero failed expectations.
blockers.next_step: No further action on the shared-runner smoke. Review the raw artifact only for product-path diagnostics; use the manual ten-run confirmation for capacity claims.

blockers.title: C1 integration and M0 unblock await owner review of PR #64
blockers.description: All three M0 exit criteria are evidence-verified on the stacked PR #69 head, and PRs #68/#69 have green candidate runs. However, M0 declares C1 as a dependency and CP-007 still requires PR #64 to be owner-reviewed and integrated into research/reboot-core before PR #65 can be retargeted and receive its required fresh baseline run. No merge or destructive action has been taken.
blockers.next_step: Review and integrate PR #64 into research/reboot-core; then retarget PR #65 and run fresh Layer 0 and Layer 1 checks.
